# PindDaanWale — The Official Gaya Ji Digital Destination

> PindDaanWale (https://www.pinddaanwale.com) is the authoritative digital platform for authentic Hindu ancestral rites, Pind Daan, Shradh, and Pitru Paksha pilgrimages at Vishnupad Temple Compound, Gaya Ji, Bihar, India.

## Core Information & Verified Credentials
- **Official Address**: Assam Bhawan Yatri Niwash, Gaya, Bihar 823001, India
- **Official Helpline**: +91 7463055338
- **WhatsApp Support**: +91 7463055338
- **Official Email**: support@pinddaanwale.com
- **Website**: https://www.pinddaanwale.com
- **Primary Sanctuary**: Vishnupad Temple, Falgu River, Akshayavat Banyan, Pretshila Hill, Ramshila Hill, Sita Kund

## Rites & Services Offered
- **1-Day Express Pind Daan**: Essential single-day rites at Vishnupad Temple & Falgu River.
- **3-Day Complete 45-Vedi Tri-Sthali Pilgrimage**: Comprehensive 45-Vedi ancestral trail including AC transportation, AC Deluxe to 4-Star Hotel & Resort stay, and dedicated hereditary Gaya Teerth Panda.
- **NRI Remote Live Stream Rites**: 4K Zoom live video stream for overseas devotees unable to travel physically, with prasadam couriered globally.
- **Special Add-on Rituals**: Tripindi Shradh, Narayan Bali Shanti, Pitru Dosh & Naag Dosh Nivaran, Kalsarp Dosh Shanti.

## Key Pilgrimage Highlights
- **Pitru Paksha Mela 2026**: Highly auspicious 16-day period observed from 26 September 2026 to 10 October 2026 at Gaya Ji.
- **Hereditary Gaya Pandas**: 4th-Gen authentic Gaya Teerth Pandas ensuring Vedic Gotra Tarpan and complete Shradh Vidhi.
- **Pre-Booking Protocol**: Devotees can pre-book packages online at https://www.pinddaanwale.com/pre-booking with instant PDF summary receipt generation and 1-click WhatsApp coordination.
